query: SELECT idi.equipamentoSistemaId, e.nome, e.grupoNome, SUM(idi.custo) as total FROM item_despesa_importado idi LEFT JOIN equipamentos e ON idi.equipamentoSistemaId = e.id WHERE idi.periodoCustoId = 60001 AND idi.equipamentoSistemaId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY idi.equipamentoSistemaId, e.nome, e.grupoNome ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;
